title: Vitrification evidence of ancient nuclear exchanges
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Vitrification evidence of ancient nuclear exchanges, about antiquity at various ancient sites, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: folks you know there's evidence of nuclear exchanges in vast antiquity I mean there's you know there's vitrification at various ancient sites

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani says on Jesse Michels's podcast that there is evidence of nuclear wars in the very distant past. He points to vitrification, rock or sand melted into glass, at various ancient sites. If true, it would mean some advanced civilization had nuclear weapons long before modern times.
